status: record of completed experiment; diagnostic follow-up is evaluation only
dataset_protocol: CG-A transductive full chart, no held-out CSI split

score.candidate_edges: undirected union of original directed D_geo top128; same W as baseline
score.log_scale: median over directed top128 of log(||Y0_i-Y0_j||)-log(D_geo_ij)
score.first_order_compatibility: B_ij=1 if residual <= median(residual)+MAD(residual), symmetric union, diagonal zero

fixed_edge_change.selection: bottom 10 percent by T, random tie break from default_rng(10)

controls.first_order: same eligible count, largest first-order residual
controls.seed10_random: same eligible edge count per D_geo decile, default_rng(10)
controls.uniform_mass: all W weights scaled to match SC2 total edge weight

metrics.ct_tw_ks: same Python random.sample seed10 subset of 4199 samples
metrics.affine_errors: full 20997 samples, each embedding aligned independently
metrics.ground_truth: offline evaluation and post-hoc diagnosis only; never score, select, weight, or tune edges
